pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is invoked while the PM (precompile) mode is active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token

operator_removal_required.meaning: recovery from the bad vaultSupplied entry requires an operator to call removeSuppliedEntry

assumptions: executeHedge registers the spot asset in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply as described in execute_hedge_buys_and_registers.
The bad registry entry is the one created by executeHedge for a token with no BLP reserve.

unresolved.description: The report states recovery requires an operator call to removeSuppliedEntry but does not define an observable completion/self-recovery relation beyond that operator dependency; the relation is encoded as the absence of the operator-removal requirement.

limitations: Only the recovery_requires_operator impact is formalized; the suppliedBalance revert and settlement bricking impacts are handled in separate passes.
The report does not state who calls executeHedge or whether it is permissionless.
